name: Whisperer, Lesser
body:
Lesser Whisperer
CR 10

This tall, looming, faceless creature is impossibly thin and impeccably dressed.

XP 9,600
NE Large fey
Init +13; Senses blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +28
Aura distortion (30 ft., DC 28)

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 19, flat-footed 17 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 insight, -1 size, +3 natural)
hp 150 (20d6+80); fast healing 5
Fort +10, Ref +16, Will +17
Defensive Abilities anticipation, faceless; Immune cold, mind-affecting effects, gaze attacks, poison, scent-based attacks, sonic DR 15/cold iron; SR 21

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +15 (1d8+5/19-20) and mist tendrils +15 touch (6d6/19-20 plus cursed wound)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks cursed wound
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +18)

Constant—detect thoughts
At will—darkness, dimension door, gaseous form, ghost sound (DC 18), invisibility, paranoia (DC 20), selective invisibility, suggestion (DC 21)
3/day—quickened confusion (DC 22), crushing despair (DC 22), hold person (DC 21), phantasmal killer (DC 22)
1/day—dominate person (DC 23), nightmare (DC 23)

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 19, Con 18, Int 19, Wis 20, Cha 27
Base Atk +10; CMB +16; CMD 36
Feats Combat Reflexes, Dimensional Agility, Dodge, Improved Critical (claw, mist tendrils), Improved Initiative, Quicken Spell-Like Ability (confusion), Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Focus (claw, mist tendrils)
Skills Escape Artist +27, Intimidate +28, Knowledge (arcana, planes) +24, Knowledge (geography, local, nature) +27, Perception +28, Sense Motive +28, Stealth +29
Languages Aklo, Common, Sylvan (can’t speak); telepathy 100 ft.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Anticipation (Ex)

A lesser whisperer applies its Wisdom modifier to initiative checks and as an insight bonus to its Armor Class.

Cursed Wound (Su)

Damage caused by a whisperer’s mist tendrils overcomes all damage reduction and ignores all hardness, but damage the tendrils deal to objects is halved. Mist tendril damage does not heal naturally. A character attempting to use magical healing on a creature damaged in this way must succeed at a DC 21 caster level check or the healing has no effect on the injured creature. Mist tendrils are primary natural touch attacks that create deep, bloodless, crater-shaped wounds.

Distortion Aura (Su)

All creatures within 30 feet of a lesser whisperer experience significant sensory distortion that grows harsher the closer they are to the lesser whisperer. The first time it ends its turn within the aura, a creature must make a DC 28 Will save or become sickened for as long as it stays within the aura. If the creature succeeds at the saving throw, it cannot be affected again by the sickening effect of this aura for another 24 hours. Creatures 30 feet from a lesser whisperer take a -2 penalty on Perception and concentration checks, which increases by 2 for every 5 feet that the creature is closer to a lesser whisperer (up to -12 for the creatures adjacent). This effect is not affected by the Will save. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Faceless (Ex)

A lesser whisperer has no face, but can still see in all directions as if its entire body were an eye. It is immune to gaze attacks, but not to vision-based illusions. It has no need to breathe, and is immune to all inhaled and scent-based effects.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

The so-called lesser whisperers arise when a whisperer, in a rare outburst of hatred, decides to affect the territories that lie beyond its domain. It does so by proxy, twisting other fey into these lesser whisperers, and then sending them on tasks of terror, ranging from stalking to violent killing sprees. For most whisperers, the favorite material for the creation of such minions is the bogeyman. Capable, shrewd killers, which mortals already associate with fear, prove to be able extensions of their will. Lesser whisperers are even more hideously long, thin and lanky than bogeymen.

Their skin loses color and their facial features dissipate, bringing their visage closer to their master. They serve only his inscrutable mind, without a will of their own.

Lesser whisperers are dangerous in combat, but open confrontation is not their strongest suit and never the preferred choice. Instead, they prefer to stalk targets using their vast array of spell-like abilities. Breaking minds, paralyzing and even dominating targets to do their bidding are common weapons in their arsenal, as well as their ability to become selectively invisible, making a single opponent fall into paranoia as their allies fail to find the root of their fear. If push comes to shove, lesser whisperers can teleport into enemy ranks and slaughter enemies with their cursed mist tendrils that leave wounds which resist all healing.

For an unknown reason, lesser whisperers radiate a distorting aura, most commonly perceived as abrasive static invading the senses. Within it, concentration is nearimpossible, and some lesser whisperers like to remain close to their opponents in prolonged invisibility, reveling in the mental strain that this effect puts onto people.

An average lesser whisperer is 9 feet tall, but weighs only 300 pounds.
